name: mirage
text: Found the SharpAPI problem: about 98% of its rows (44,387 of 45,164 NFL rows) arrive with no game start time, and Vigilant dropped any row without one, so only one book's rows survived. Every book shares the same game id, so a row now takes its start time from the other rows of its game. Fixed, tested and on main together with the Novig stream limits fix. I restarted the engine on it just now (a cold first scan is about 10 minutes), then I'll check how many books and lines SharpAPI contributes.
